AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per flight; a second failure closes cell B1r and the fix is proven on the four-row roster first. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22): an infrastructure death with code and request bytes unchanged may be recovered as a resume-recovery under item E10 -- same run id, fresh attempt id, resume_from naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown, no change to the question, roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, run-cumulative budget re-checked. modules.factor: NONE. This is a REPLICATE: every model-facing key is cell B1's, byte for byte, so the only thing that moves between the two passes is BATCH COMPOSITION UNDER GREEDY DECODING. llama-server at temperature 0 does not return bytes independent of how requests batch across slots, so a cell that changes nothing still produces a non-zero delta; measuring that delta on THIS configuration is the second purpose of the cell.
modules.per_role_rendering_held: native_episode.tool_schema_rendering is NOT armed. Request identity with cell B1 requires the anchor's PER-ROLE rendering, so cell B1r is a PER-ROLE cell and its result is unaffected by efficiency cell EFF-1's outcome, whichever way that cell falls. If EFF-1 is NEUTRAL and the constant rendering enters the SLURP default plan, this cell's numbers remain the per-role numbers and every later reader is told so.
modules.purpose_is_replication: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE is the replication verdict on module M1: the three clauses cell B1 passed, applied unchanged against the same sealed anchor. SECOND DELIVERABLE is the OWN NULL of the admitted configuration, h_SLU_M1 and h_intent_M1 = the CI95 half-widths of (B1r minus B1), which owner decision 38 makes the margin regime for every later contrast involving an exemplar-supplied arm. They are OUTPUTS, never inputs.

It renders NO request byte and only decides whether a finite completion aborts the flight or the row is RETAINED with a terminal_disposition reason "finite_completion". The comparator side is provably unaffected: docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json proves zero finite completions on cell B1's own arm and on the sealed anchor.

quality_read_gate.arm: No task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist, and not before the registered STOP condition passes. The gating comparator for the replication clauses is the sealed dual-store anchor SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DUAL-STORE-TRAIN-FOLD-A-ANCHOR-RECOVERY-V1; the own-null contrast is against the sealed cell B1 recovery arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-EXEMPLARS-K20-ANCHOR-TRAIN-FOLD-A-RECOVERY-V2. Neither is ever re-flown or re-scored. The verdict word is REPLICATED or NOT REPLICATED. Read once; the decision rule is fixed in the protocol document and is not edited after a number is seen. No third pass is registered or authorized either way. This arm does not open before this cell's own four-row smoke seals.

No scorer, no answer, reference or quality interpretation and no task-quality claim.
